title: Race Condition on Simultaneous Order Claiming
rootCause: Non-atomic findOne followed by save permitted race condition under concurrent order acceptance.
resolution: Enforced atomic findOneAndUpdate with lock condition { deliveryPartner: null, deliveryStatus: 'WAITING', vendorStatus: 'READY' }.

title: Verification Documents Leaked in Non-Admin Profile Payload
rootCause: formatUserResponse did not strip deliveryPartnerProfile.documents object for non-admin callers.
resolution: Enforced strict conditional deletion of documents object unless caller role === 'admin'.

title: 4th Featured Product Limit Bypass via Concurrent Toggles
rootCause: Product.countDocuments() count check was not guarded by transaction or atomic state lock.
resolution: Added backend validation rejecting toggle if count of existing featured products is >= 3.

title: Vendor State Machine Transition Bypass to Delivery Status
rootCause: Vendor status update endpoint accepted any order status enum without validating role boundary.
resolution: Strictly limited vendor transitions to [ACCEPTED, PREPARING, READY, REJECTED] halting vendor control at READY.

title: Delivery Completion Permitted Without Customer OTP Validation
rootCause: Transition to DELIVERED did not enforce mandatory matching deliveryOtp comparison.
resolution: Implemented mandatory OTP verification returning 400 Bad Request if missing or mismatching.

title: Floating Cart Quantity Desynchronization on Rapid Clicks
rootCause: Non-debounced asynchronous network requests caused UI badge count to drift from backend total.
resolution: Optimistic cart queueing added in CartContext to handle rapid click streams synchronously.
